articles.title: Introducing gpt-oss
articles.description: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
articles.raw_content: We’re releasing gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b—two state-of-the-art open-weight language models that deliver strong real-world performance at low cost. Available under the flexible Apache 2.0 license, these models outperform similarly sized open models on reasoning tasks, demonstrate strong tool use capabilities, and are optimized for efficient deployment on consumer hardware.
articles.selection_reason: OpenAI releasing state-of-the-art open-weight models under Apache 2.0 is a landmark shift that reshapes what researchers and early adopters can build and fine-tune locally.
articles.audience_value: Direct access to frontier-class reasoning and tool-use models that can be inspected, fine-tuned, and deployed without API lock-in.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators gain an open, permissively licensed frontier model to experiment on, accelerating novel research and applications previously gated behind closed APIs.

articles.title: Advancing science and math with GPT-5.2
articles.description: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI’s strongest model yet for math and science, setting new state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath. This post shows how those gains translate into real research progress, including solving an open theoretical problem and generating reliable mathematical proofs.
articles.raw_content: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI’s strongest model yet for math and science, setting new state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath. This post shows how those gains translate into real research progress, including solving an open theoretical problem and generating reliable mathematical proofs.
articles.selection_reason: GPT-5.2 setting new SOTA on GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath while solving an open theoretical problem marks a concrete milestone for AI-driven science.
articles.audience_value: Evidence of how frontier models are translating benchmark gains into real mathematical proofs and research progress.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators need to understand where AI can now genuinely co-author discoveries, redefining the research workflow for the next five years.

articles.title: AMD and OpenAI announce strategic partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD GPUs
articles.description: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
articles.raw_content: AMD and OpenAI have announced a multi-year partnership to deploy 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs, beginning with 1 gigawatt in 2026, to power OpenAI’s next-generation AI infrastructure and accelerate global AI innovation.
articles.selection_reason: A 6-gigawatt AMD GPU deployment breaks Nvidia's de facto monopoly on frontier compute and signals the scale of next-generation AI infrastructure.
articles.audience_value: Insight into the compute roadmap that will determine which models and capabilities become feasible through 2030.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators tracking the frontier must understand the hardware diversification that will shape model scale, cost, and availability.

articles.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
articles.description: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.
articles.raw_content: OpenAI is giving 100,000 academic researchers free access to ChatGPT's most advanced AI models to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery.
articles.selection_reason: Free frontier-model access for 100,000 academic researchers is a major intervention in the research ecosystem with broad discovery implications.
articles.audience_value: A potential direct benefit for academic readers and a signal of how AI labs are courting the scientific community.
articles.why_this_matters: Why this matters: Innovators in academia can secure advanced tooling now, while everyone else should watch how this accelerates AI-native research output.

articles.title: Co-Scientist: A multi-agent AI partner to accelerate research
articles.description: Introducing Co-Scientist, a collaborative AI partner built with Gemini to help researchers accelerate scientific breakthroughs.
